name: What's the fire glass depth for best flame pattern?

mainEntity.name: What's the fire glass depth for best flame pattern?

acceptedAnswer.text: 1/4"-1/2" diameter glass to 3-4" above burner; too shallow looks sparse, too deep smothers flames.

description: 1/4"-1/2" diameter glass to 3-4" above burner; too shallow looks sparse, too deep smothers flames.
